Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and supporting evidence for procurement

Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking this — Fintechorp Payments is progressing through vendor security review for a payments integration we plan to pilot Q3. Our procurement/security team needs the following to advance a POC contract: 

- Full SOC 2 Type II report covering security and availability for the last 12-month audit period (PDF).
- Any bridge letter your auditor can provide if the report period does not cover our go-live date.
- An index (CSV preferred) listing process artifacts or evidence owners we can request if needed (system architecture diagrams, change control logs, third-party vendor list, encryption key management notes).

Can you confirm the audit period and expected delivery method (secure link / SFTP / portal)? Also, if you have a short list of redacted items you typically share and items you withhold (e.g., live customer data, raw logs), that would speed approvals.

Do you have a timeline for delivering the report? Procurement would like the report and any bridge letter within 2 weeks to keep the timeline intact.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Diane Reyes
Head of Vendor Security, Fintechorp Payments
D: +1 415-555-0147

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and supporting evidence for procurement

Diane — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can support this. A few clarifying points so we provide exactly what your procurement team needs: 

1) Audit period: our most recent Type II covers 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 (audit performed by Brightline Auditors, LLP). If you need coverage through a later date, we can provide a bridge letter; please confirm whether a time-limited bridge letter is acceptable to procurement. 

2) Delivery method: we prefer to deliver the report and sensitive evidence via a pre-signed S3 link with a 7-day expiry or via a secure portal. We will not send full raw logs or customer PII.

3) Evidence index: we normally share an evidence index (CSV) that maps sections of the report to available artifacts and the internal owner. I am attaching our executive summary and an evidence-index template you can use to flag priority items.

4) Redactions and exclusions: standard redactions include specific customer identifiers, production logs with PII, and some vendor contract commercial terms. We can supply redacted architecture diagrams, control narratives, and change-control artifacts.

5) Timeline: we can deliver the PDF report + bridge letter (if requested) within 3 business days of confirming delivery method and the exact scope your team requires. If you need additional artifacts listed in the evidence index, expect a 5–10 business day turnaround depending on owner availability.

Suggested next steps: 
- Confirm: (a) bridge letter acceptable, (b) preferred delivery method (S3 link or portal), and (c) any controls you want us to prioritize in the evidence index.
- We will upload the report and the evidence-index CSV to a secure link and send reviewer access.

For procurement convenience, here is a short reply template you can forward to your stakeholders to record acceptance quickly: 

"Fintechorp Procurement accepts the SOC 2 Type II report delivered via secure link and acknowledges standard redactions for PII and commercial terms. A bridge letter will be acceptable for interim coverage. Procurement authorizes access request HS-983421."

I'll hold on the upload until I hear how you'd like it delivered. Looping in Marissa (Legal) and Monica (Customers & Security operations) to assist if we need any unusual redactions or contract coordination.

Thanks,

Ava Chen
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0192
